title: How is play therapy incorporated into your occupational therapy approach at Pinnacle Blooms?
metaTitle: Play Therapy in Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network incorporates play therapy into their occupational therapy sessions to engage children and teach new skills and behaviours.
html: For kids, play is not just fun, it's a learning process. At Pinnacle Blooms, we incorporate play therapy into our occupational therapy sessions. It allows children to learn new skills in a fun, engaging, and natural environment that makes them comfortable. Our experienced therapists use unique play strategies that become a powerful tool for teaching essential behaviors and skills.
